com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote

Class Quote

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.Quote
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Iterable<Quote.FieldItem>

    public abstract class Quote
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.lang.Iterable<Quote.FieldItem>
    Purpose of this class is to hold Quote information. A Quote contains collection of Quote.FieldItem. The API user can get access to the field item value(s) in one of the following ways:
    • The API user can use Iterator.hasNext() and Iterator.next() methods to iterate over the items. The Quote.FieldItem that is returned by Iterator.next() is only valid during that iteration. Quote.FieldItem is reused internally by the iterator to reduce object creation.
    • The API user can use getFieldItem(short) and isFieldItemNull(short) methods to directly access a known item.
    • The API user can use Quote.FieldItem.getValue() method to get the data as Object or Quote.FieldItem#getValueAs* methods (e.g. Quote.FieldItem.getValueAsInteger(boolean)) to get the data as a primitive value.
    Since:
    01-001-0007
    Author:
    Interactive Data
    See Also:
    QuoteManager, FIELDFORMAT
